name: Kookaburra
changes: New notification system: animated stacking notes with progress timers, pause on hover, swipe to dismiss, merged duplicates, undo actions and a notification history under the bell.
Background effects (snow, rain, stars, fireflies, sakura, bubbles, embers), each defined as JSON in public/assets/json.
Changeable background: upload an image, paste a link, or turn it off.
About shows the build time in eastern Australian time and the active gudday clients.

name: Kookaburra
changes: Fully static: hosts on GitHub Pages (or any static host) with no server and no config file.
Proxy traffic now goes over Wisp, with a configurable server in Settings > General.
Game feeds load straight from the browser, are cached for instant repeat visits, and fill in source by source.
Works from a subpath like /gudday/; app files are cached by the service worker for fast reloads.

name: Kookaburra
changes: Added YouTube Playables and CKV game sources.
The proxy now waits for an updated service worker before starting, so fixes take effect without a stale worker in between.
Responses that arrive without headers are repaired instead of failing the request.
About shows which service worker version is running.

name: Kookaburra
changes: Fixed YouTube showing "You're offline": request bodies were being dropped in Firefox, so every POST went out empty.
Lighter liquid glass: panels use a pre-frosted copy of the background instead of live blur.
About now shows the version, changelog and the latest build from GitHub.

name: Wombat
changes: Home page with logo and search that opens the built-in browser.
Games library with 3,000+ games from Selenite, Zones, Velara and Truffled, with thumbnails and per-source counts.
Settings with themes, performance mode, cloaking and history.
